{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv'
raw_data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = raw_data.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print the mean flipper lengths directly to ensure they are captured
print(mean_flipper_by_species)

# Identify the species with the highest mean
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()

# Print the result
print(f"Species with highest mean flipper length: {highest_mean_species}")"}
